publication_scope: Curated original authored-car display derivatives only. No new rendering, geometry changes, game/reference captures, private desktop/notes or model binaries.
date_policy: Record-set dates identify the source documentation family. Original render timestamps are unrecorded unless separately stated; no filesystem mtime is presented as a capture date.
display_derivation: ImageMagick deterministic JPEG display derivatives and thumbnails only; fit within 1440x1100 and 480x340 without upscaling; quality88/84, 4:4:4, metadata stripped. No crop, retouch, color adjustment, AI generation. JPEG display derivatives are not pixel-identical proof.
